subject: Request: Cross-team evaluation — extra credits & short extension
body:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@cirrusai.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 11:12:00 -0400
Subject: Cross-team evaluation — short extension and additional credits

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the throughput and the latency profiling. We have three engineering squads (Search, Relevance, and Inference) that want to run larger, parallelized evaluations over the next six weeks to stress test latency and cost at our expected scale.

Our existing sandbox quota and the PLG trial limits will run out before we can finish the cross-team benchmarks. Procurement is ready to issue a PO for services if we can get a short runway extension and an allocation of complimentary tokens to cover the first phase of work.

Specifically, can Redwood approve a 45-day extension to the trial window and an extra 250k free tokens for evaluation (we estimate this will cover roughly 2–3 large experiments per team)? I attached our PO template and a high-level eval plan.

This is time-sensitive — teams are lined up to start next week. Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through the numbers.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Head of Platform Engineering
CirrusAI

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: elaine@cirrusai.com
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 12:25:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Cross-team evaluation — short extension and additional credits

Team — forwarding CirrusAI's ask (see attachments). TL;DR: three squads want to run parallel stress tests; they need 45 extra days and ~250k free tokens to finish phase 1. Procurement will issue a PO contingent on our approval.

Why this matters: CirrusAI is a focused mid-market account with heavy inference needs and an active engineering bar. If we let the teams complete the evaluations under Redwood, we displace other providers and position for a dedicated capacity conversation in Q1.

Current PLG policy: standard trial extension is 14 days and max complimentary tokens 100k for one-off escalations. This request is outside our standard bounds.

Ask: Marissa / Karthik — can we get an exec-level exception (45 days, 250k tokens) and a short-term 10% usage discount for the evaluation period? If approved, procurement is ready to sign the attached PO and we can lock a follow-up meeting to discuss Dedicated opportunities.

I recommend we:
- Approve the extension and token uplift as a one-off for CirrusAI (deal team to own handoff).
- Require PO + standard MSA addendum (30-day billing hold until PO clears).
- Capture evaluation metrics and a short MQL to trigger the Dedicated outreach.

Happy to provide cost delta and token burn projections — see attached quick table.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
---

+1 from me. CirrusAI is strategic in the mid-market verticals we're targeting given the inference-heavy use case. Allowing the full cross-team run will materially increase chances of an enterprise commitment; we should treat this as a controlled pilot.

Conditions I want in writing:
- PO on file before credits are applied.
- Extension capped at 45 days, clearly labelled as one-off complimentary evaluation credits.
- Measurement reminder: we get access to perf logs and cost breakdowns during the eval period and they feed into our Redwood Optimize recommendations.

I can approve subject to Hannah giving final sign-off on the token uplift — want to keep a single executive stamp for out-of-bound grants. Ben, loop Hannah and include your cost delta and the SOW highlight.

Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Couple of operational notes:
- Finance requires the PO to reference HS-73921 so we can match billing.
- If we mark the credits as one-off evaluation credits, we should set an expiry 30 days after the extension ends (clear expiration avoids ongoing credits).
- Legal will want the SOW addendum; I can draft a standard one that includes the measurement access clause and data handling assurances.

I'll prepare a quick cost delta (expected marginal cost ~ $2.8k for the 250k tokens under current infra mix) and a one-page handoff checklist.

Karthik
Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

Hannah — looping you in for final sign-off on the token uplift (250k) and the 45-day trial extension. Below is the quick impact summary:

- Customer: CirrusAI (mid-market, potential Dedicated capacity in Q1)
- Ask: 45-day extension + 250k complimentary tokens + temporary 10% usage discount for evaluation period
- Expected marginal cost to Redwood: ~$2.8k (one-time infra marginals)
- Strategic value: High (multiple squads ready to benchmark full-scale inference; referenceable mid-market win)
- Requirements from CirrusAI: PO referencing HS-73921, SOW addendum granting perf/cost logs access, credits expire 30 days after extension

If you approve, I'll notify Procurement to attach the PO and Legal to prepare the SOW addendum. Elapsed timeline: teams plan to start Sept 13.

Ben
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

1) PO on file (must reference HS-73921).
2) Credits applied only after PO verification.
3) Credits and discount automatically expire 30 days after the extension ends.
4) Handoff plan to Customer Success and an executive debrief scheduled within 10 days after the evaluation completes.

Karthik — please draft the short SOW addendum and cost sheet. Marissa — Ben will coordinate the PO flow. Ben/Marissa, circle me if anything changes.
